purpose: Make VRAM calculator assumptions explicit and versioned. This is a planning estimate, not a benchmark.

llmEstimatePolicy.description: Estimate weights memory from parameter count and quantization bits, then add context/runtime overhead and safety margin.
llmEstimatePolicy.formula: estimatedVramGb = ((modelSizeB * quantizationBits) / 8) * overheadMultiplier + contextOverheadGb + runtimeOverheadGb + safetyMarginGb
llmEstimatePolicy.warning: This does not model every architecture, KV cache implementation, batch size, offloading setup, or runtime-specific optimization.
